on_screen_text.text: New reporting reveals Pam Bondi told Trump in May that his name appeared 'multiple times' in the Epstein files.

When Justice Department officials reviewed what Attorney General Pam Bondi called a 'truckload' of documents related to Jeffrey Epstein earlier this year, they discovered that Donald Trump's name appeared multiple times, according to senior administration officials.

audio_music: A single, ominous-sounding hip-hop track ('She Knows' by J. Cole) plays throughout the video. The repeated lyric 'She knows' creates a suggestive and suspenseful tone that aligns with the on-screen text about what Pam Bondi allegedly told Donald Trump.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced slideshow of three static images: a tweet screenshot, an article screenshot, and a photograph.
cultural_references: The video uses the song 'She Knows' by the rapper J. Cole.
central_claim: Donald Trump was aware that his name appeared multiple times in the Jeffrey Epstein files because Pam Bondi informed him.
intended_effect: To create suspicion around Donald Trump and link him to the Jeffrey Epstein scandal.
